for i,f in enumerate(report,1):
 b=(base/"tree-only-blobs"/pathlib.Path(f["File"]).name).read_bytes()
 lines=b.decode("utf-8").splitlines()
 source="\n".join(lines[max(0,f["StartLine"]-2):f["EndLine"]+1])
 parts=f["Match"].split("REDACTED")
 values=set()
 if len(parts)==2 and parts[0] and parts[1]:

print(json.dumps({"rows":out,"matched_rows":sum(x["mapped_candidates"]==1 for x in out),"values_withheld":True},indent=2))
